entries.behavior: Asks the system whether a process exists and when it started, which tells a process from a later one with the same number; where it cannot be asked it claims nothing.

simplification.attempt: The existing CPU adapter lists every process of the machine; one ps call for one number was smaller than filtering that list.

performance.attempt: One ps call for each registered agent that named a process; none for the others. The time is unavailable: nothing measures this unit by itself.

entries.behavior: Declares harness activity show, register, heartbeat, finish and agents.

simplification.attempt: The options an agent may restate are declared once for register and heartbeat.

performance.attempt: Not applicable.

entries.behavior: After any command, an agent named by HARNESS_AGENT_ID gets a heartbeat.

simplification.attempt: None attempted: one call.

performance.attempt: Without the variable nothing is read. With it, one registration is read and one small file written after the command.

entries.behavior: The activity commands are part of the program.

entries.behavior: Names what project activity is made of: the three files an agent writes about itself, a roster entry with its state, committed work with loop types, commits and files, and what only a running Harness can add: checkouts with uncommitted changes and the roster.

simplification.attempt: One shape serves the recorded and the live activity, with live state in a type of its own, instead of two parallel models.

performance.attempt: Not applicable: types and three small schemas.

entries.behavior: Says whether a registered agent is working at a given moment: an end is final, a process that is gone or whose number another process has is not the agent, and otherwise only a heartbeat within the time the agent allowed counts. A process that merely exists proves nothing.

simplification.attempt: It is one pure function over stated facts; asking the system about a process is a function it is handed, and only when the owner named a process.

performance.attempt: No process is asked about for an agent that named none. The time is unavailable: nothing measures this unit by itself.

entries.behavior: Checks what an owner may state about an agent: a label, provider, model, task, loop and outcome as one short line each, unit ids of a fixed shape, a process number and the seconds between heartbeats, and gives them in the form they are kept.

simplification.attempt: Every line of text goes through one check with a table of limits instead of a check per field.

performance.attempt: Not applicable: a few string checks per command.

entries.behavior: The activity commands are named in what a command is recorded as.

simplification.attempt: None attempted: one line in the table.

performance.attempt: Not applicable.

simplification.attempt: None attempted: one name in the pattern.

performance.attempt: Not applicable.

simplification.attempt: None attempted: one name in the pattern.

performance.attempt: It adds the size of one small file to what is bundled; not measured.

entries.behavior: An installed host loads the bundled activity module with the index.

simplification.attempt: None attempted: one path in the list.

performance.attempt: Not applicable.

simplification.attempt: None attempted: one name in the list.

entries.behavior: Counts how often each loop type was used and how many of those loops are complete, the most used type first; a loop without a template is custom.

simplification.attempt: Nothing simpler was found than one grouping pass.

performance.attempt: One pass over the tracked loops, 27 in this repository. The time is unavailable: nothing measures this unit by itself.

entries.behavior: Assembles what a project did, the same way for a history index and for a checkout: loop types, the newest commits with the units that own what they changed and the distinct reasons noted on them, and each changed file once at its newest commit, owned files first.

simplification.attempt: The recorded and the live activity share this one assembler; what differs is only where commits, reasons, changes and owners are read from.

performance.attempt: Bounded by the limits it is given: commits, files and reasons per commit. The time is unavailable: nothing measures this unit by itself.

entries.behavior: Tells which units own a path from what each unit lists: a file, or a directory with everything under it. A path nobody lists has no owner.

simplification.attempt: Files are looked up in a map built once; only directory entries are scanned.

performance.attempt: A map lookup for each path instead of a scan of 573 units for each. The time is unavailable: nothing measures this unit by itself.
